description: The endpoint answered 429 through the relay three times, with no Retry-After: the vercel engine sent the request again twice, after 1 s and then 2 s, saying so with a retry event each time, then reports the third refusal. A Retry-After over 30 s is reported at the first refusal, with retryAt. requestId and retryAt are added where the provider's headers carry them.

items.message: The AI provider is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
